notes.title: A First Person Ice Climbing Game
notes.notes:
[h1]Thanks for checking out the page[/h1]

The game is in early development as you will see from the first devlog. Looking to get the game out Q2 next year. 

The Long Cold is a game about ice climbing out of a crevasse. I'm taking inspiration from games like Peaks of Yore, Cairn and Bennett Foddy's games. it will have multiplayer so you'll be able to climb with others (I'm still figuring out the ice screw system working for multiple people as it might in real world climbing).

Something the Steam page needs like a trailer and GIFs are in the works at the moment while trying to balance full time work and ensuring a smooth player experience for this project.

I'm working solo on this project, if you're interested in working on it, let me know by reaching out to me on X @HENRY_MEAD_ or emailing me at mode24agency@gmail.com.
